origin: Praga Racing emerged from the dedicated passion of a group of Czech motorsport enthusiasts in the early 2000s. Initially, the team was little more than a weekend hobby for a group of friends centered around a small garage in Prague. Led by the charismatic and driven Petr Novotný, the team's early days were characterized by cobbled-together racing machines and a 'never say die' attitude. A pivotal moment came in 2008 when they secured a surprise podium finish at a local endurance race, attracting the attention of a small but crucial sponsor that allowed them to significantly upgrade their equipment.
philosophy: Praga Racing's philosophy revolves around methodical improvement and leveraging data to maximize performance. While their resources are considerable for an amateur team, they focus on squeezing every last drop of potential from their existing equipment rather than chasing radical innovations. The team fosters a culture of open communication and shared responsibility, believing that a cohesive and motivated team is just as important as horsepower.
achievements: 2008: Podium finish at the Czech National Endurance Race
2012: Winner of the Central European Touring Car Championship (Amateur Class)
2015: Multiple class wins in the Slovakian Hill Climb Championship
2018: Top 10 finish in the GT4 European Series (Selected Races)

teamPrincipal.name: Petr Novotný
teamPrincipal.background: Petr is a lifelong motorsport enthusiast who transitioned from amateur racer to team manager. His hands-on approach and deep understanding of the technical aspects of racing have been instrumental in Praga Racing's success.

keyFigures.name: Jana Svobodová
keyFigures.description: Jana is a brilliant engineer responsible for optimizing the car's setup and performance. Her data-driven approach has consistently delivered incremental improvements.

headquarters: Praga Racing operates from a modestly sized but well-equipped workshop on the outskirts of Prague. While the facilities are not cutting-edge, they are meticulously maintained and provide a solid base for the team's operations. The team also has access to a private test track.
fanBase: Praga Racing enjoys a loyal following among Czech motorsport enthusiasts. They are seen as a plucky underdog team that punches above its weight, and their consistent performance has earned them a dedicated fanbase at local races.
